features: Metadata-only detection of standard source locations
Custom path precedence and persisted source action switches
Shared manifest, reader, transform and Action contract for built-in and trusted local user adapters
User-over-built-in precedence and optional built-in parser reuse
Startup-only adapter capture; no module hot loading
Registry and system shortcut eligibility synchronized after configuration changes
regression_coverage: Recent configuration selection across IDEA variants
Detection does not parse history bodies
Missing automatic source found on later page open
Custom paths never silently fall back
Action switches retain custom paths across restart and revoke old execution
No closed action in search or shortcut targets
Settings reconcile system hotkeys even after an uncertain save response
User definitions register their own Action and can reuse built-in readers
Same-ID override yields one source and cannot change built-in application identity
Invalid user packages fail closed for history without disabling other native features
Removed user definitions leave inactive preferences without blocking built-ins
Legacy closed built-ins do not disable newly introduced user adapters
Configuration containment, size limits and unknown schemas
